scope: Read-only source review plus CPU SHA-256/AST checks. No detector execution, feature extraction, GPU, training or sealed-test data read.

paper.title: ReDeEP: Detecting Hallucination in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Mechanistic Interpretability

author_source.parameter_files_under_test_named_directo: Only head lists and hyperparameters, not responses or predicted scores.

input.fields: Published source prompt, model-specific response and human span labels for evaluation/selection; chunk variant additionally requires prompt_spans/response_spans.
input.response: Concatenate original published response; tokenize full string independently from prefix.
input.model_filter: Only answers whose model equals selected detector model.
input.extra_generated_answer_styles: The added3046 cohort replayed with one Llama2 detector is cross-generator adaptation.

token_timing.target_interpretation: predictor at target token position minus one
token_timing.last_target: Last target has predecessor score; no post-read last-token signal.
token_timing.gold_mapping_issue: Independent prefix tokenization, prefix-substring retokenization of annotation edges and inclusive end; labels are checked on seq_i without explicit +1 target alignment.

token_ecs.head_candidates: Precomputed topk_heads.json; 7B32/13B40/3-8B32 heads, emitted in layer/head traversal order.
token_ecs.hidden: mean selected prefix final states vs same-predictor final state cosine
token_ecs.output: one scalar per token per candidate head

token_pks.before: attention-residual sum before post_attention_layernorm and FFN
token_pks.projection: shared final RMSNorm and lm_head; full vocabulary softmax; final-layer hidden already normalized in original complete-layer path.

chunk.code_splitter: Consumes precomputed spans; generation script absent from locked repository tree.
chunk.attention_pair_code: sum over query/key pairs, argmax first
chunk.ecs: BGE normalized embedding dot product of selected source chunk and response chunk
chunk.pks_paper: mean per-token standard JSD within chunk
chunk.pks_code: sum per-token reverse-KL mixture after vocabulary sum; no token function's 1e6/V factor
code_extra_issues: Llama3 extracts layers0..15 while reg expects32 PKS columns.
Llama2-13B extracts layers8..39 but emitted parameter keys enumerate0..31.
Prompt token mapping includes hard-coded minus4.

trainer.actual_paper_choice: Grid search over a fixed signed linear combination, not neural classifier training.
trainer.unused_lr: linear_regression defines LogisticRegression(max_iter=10000) and an 80/20 random token split but is never invoked by main.
trainer.code_rank: Per-feature AUROC, ECS against safe label and PKS against hallucination label; Pearson computed but not used.
trainer.source_main_search: run_all=False; fixed selected counts/beta rather than a complete published validation search loop
trainer.minmax: Re-fitted on all rows of current input dataframe; component extrema and final answer extrema saved in parameter records but not applied by the standalone reg to independent holdout.
trainer.response_score_formula: component MinMax, z_t = P_t_normalized - beta E_t_normalized; mean_t z_t; final MinMax across answers
trainer.output_main: Only answer AUC and PCC JSON

thresholds.search_objective_and_ties: Not specified by released detection code or paper threshold table.
thresholds.thresholded_f1_main_implementation: Not present in released reg main path.
thresholds.paper_metrics_unit: Answer, with response hallucination label=max local gold
thresholds.common_task_mapping: Only after the complete method identity is frozen and run: copy each frozen native answer score unchanged to every eligible project 4-BPE window, then take the common answer max. This zero-parameter, label-free deterministic broadcast preserves the native answer score; internal token signals are not exposed as formal localization scores.

blockers.evidence: token_level_detect.py/chunk_level_detect.py and construct_dataframe retain split=test; feature selection and score calculation occur on those rows.
blockers.effect: No faithful independent validation-to-test implementation. Does not establish what authors actually ran for paper.
Removes required hallucination_label/PKS columns; static KeyError. Cannot silently infer intended row split.

blockers.evidence: JSD direction/scaling, source-only vs full prefix, Pearson vs AUROC, chunk sum vs mean differ.
blockers.effect: Must separately name paper-formula and pinned-code reproduction.

blockers.evidence: Head lists and token constants available, but selection sample/split manifests, candidate-head generator and chunk-span builder absent.
blockers.effect: Cannot assert current cal/test independence or reconstruct entire selection process.
NF4 is precision adaptation, not data-interface-only baseline.

blockers.evidence: Precomputed spans, hardcoded offsets, 13B/3-8B layer column mismatches.
blockers.effect: Chunk baseline requires additional verified interfaces and cannot be substituted by token variant.
